title: SampleMetadata
description: Shared sample identity linking Process, Command, Network, and Memory feature domains for a single execution or dataset entry

sample_id.description: Canonical unique primary key across all feature sets (e.g. EXEC_20260913_001 or PUB_CIC_0042)

source_type.description: Origin of sample record: isolated sandbox execution or public reference dataset

source_id.description: Sample hash (SHA-256) or upstream public dataset identifier. Never commit live malware code.

execution_id.description: Identifier for the specific sandbox execution session (or N/A for static public dataset rows)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of execution or acquisition

operating_system.description: Target guest operating system during execution

family_label.description: Initial baseline: 0=Benign, 1=PowerShell Fileless, 2=WMI Malware, 3=Process Hollowing, 4=Reflective DLL Injection, 5=Registry Malware (subject to Phase 1 finalization)

operator.description: Track owner or automated harness that conducted the run (Track A / Track B / Public)

notes.description: Non-sensitive operational or forensic notes regarding execution anomalies or configuration
